property_summary: For any sender, a call to sendMoney that causes the target to revert must also revert the call; the buggy version (missing onlyOwner) allows non-owners to attempt the call and falsely succeed when the target reverts but the low-level call returns false, requiring the assertion.
change_summary: Move the onlyOwner modifier invocation from sendMoney to allow unchecked external calls from any sender.
